svg.aria-label: Close-grip bench press, Top: Hold the bar above your chest with a shoulder-width overhand grip.
svg.title: Close-grip bench press, Top: Hold the bar above your chest with a shoulder-width overhand grip.

svg.aria-label: Close-grip bench press, Lower: Lower the bar with your elbows close to your sides.
svg.title: Close-grip bench press, Lower: Lower the bar with your elbows close to your sides.

svg.aria-label: Close-grip bench press, Chest: Touch your lower chest, elbows tucked near your ribs.
svg.title: Close-grip bench press, Chest: Touch your lower chest, elbows tucked near your ribs.

svg.aria-label: Close-grip bench press, Press: Press back up without lifting your shoulders.
svg.title: Close-grip bench press, Press: Press back up without lifting your shoulders.
